title: And Then There Were None
author: Agatha Christie
summary: Ten strangers are invited to a remote island off the English coast, where a recorded voice accuses each of them of a past crime. One by one they begin to die, following an old nursery rhyme.
readIf: you love a closed-circle puzzle where nobody can be trusted and every page ratchets up the dread.
skipIf: you want a lot of character depth or a hero to root for.

pairings.reason: Also a locked-in group of suspects and a famously clever solution, but with a detective guiding you.
A modern take on a remote, isolated setting with a murder and a cast who all have secrets.
A teen-focused update on the group-of-suspects puzzle, with a lighter touch.
